title: Uniform bound on expected weighted nonhalting cost
statement: For every natural number $c$, there is a rational number $C$ such that, for every infinite bit sequence $p$ and every natural number $K$, the sum over $0\le t<K$ of $(t+1)^c$ times the probability that the run following $p$ has not halted after $t$ random bits is at most $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is an arbitrary infinite bit sequence
